about.title: From student to
paragraphs: I joined ShipDelight when prediction systems were outsourced. We rebuilt everything in-house — from delivery prediction and analytics to risk intelligence and customer communication. Today, these systems power thousands of decisions every day.
I transform complex data into scalable ML systems that deliver measurable outcomes.
